issues.concept: Dual-system palette collision (legacy forest green vs cobalt/navy)
evidence: src/styles/index.css defines legacy forest-green #17634f / #143d36 / dark #0c1b17 alongside #F7FAFF / #0867E8 / #0B1D52 / dark #0b132b.
EVIDENCE/BEFORE/TC10_settings_1440x900.png shows full-width #17634f buttons inside a white/blue shell.
EVIDENCE/BEFORE/TC06_wa_onboarding_step1_qr_1440x900.png shows #f1f3ef canvas + green step pill beneath blue topbar shortcuts.
issues.user_consequence: Users experience disjointed transitions between green and blue surfaces, mistaking tabs for disconnected apps.
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Incremental Tailwind cobalt screens added inside legacy CSS shell without migrating existing .cg-primary/.cg-shell variables.
issues.proposed_verification: Consolidate all shell, button, and surface tokens to #F8FAFC / #FFFFFF / #0F172A / #2563EB, reserving green exclusively for WhatsApp connection indicators.

issues.concept: Dark mode white-on-white header text and mixed surface contrast failure
evidence: EVIDENCE/BEFORE/TC05_store_v5_darkmode_1440x900.png renders light/white 'NAVEGADOR 1 - Site Gerado' header text on white #FFFFFF header surface.
Sidebar turns #0c1b17 (dark green), outer workspace turns #0b132b (dark navy), while StoreV5Pane product card remains #FFFFFF with dark #0f172a form inputs.
issues.user_consequence: Pane header label becomes illegible in dark mode and luminance jumps abruptly across containers.
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Dark-mode class applies selectively to `.cg-shell` and `.dark` inputs without theme tokens on StoreV5Pane containers.
issues.proposed_verification: Measure WCAG contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 across all text/surface pairs in both light and dark modes.

issues.concept: Sub-44px interactive touch targets across desktop and mobile
evidence: 08_BROWSER_QA_REPORT.json -> Dashboard_1440x900: 15/15 (100%) interactive elements < 44px (topbar shortcuts 30px, sidebar items 36px, period <select> 18px, action buttons 28px).
08_BROWSER_QA_REPORT.json -> Store_390x844: 20/22 interactive elements < 44px (preview toggle 22px height, Publicar loja 32px, close 32px, hamburger 36px).
08_BROWSER_QA_REPORT.json -> AuthFlowView_1440x900: 5/5 controls < 44px (inputs 41px, primary button 38px, secondary link buttons 20px).
issues.user_consequence: Increased tap-miss rate on 390x844 viewports and weak visual click affordance on primary actions.
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Utility sizes (`h-8` 32px, `.cg-primary` `min-height: 36px`) applied without minimum touch-target enforcement.
issues.proposed_verification: Require `min-height: 44px` and `min-width: 44px` across all buttons, tabs, links, inputs, and selects (`sub44Count === 0` measured in Playwright).

issues.concept: Sub-14px micro-typography dominating labels and controls
evidence: 08_BROWSER_QA_REPORT.json -> Dashboard_1440x900 fontSizeHistogram: 11px (2), 12px (26), 13px (3) — 31 of 41 measured text nodes under 14px.
issues.user_consequence: Dense helper descriptions and KPI sublabels require high visual effort on laptop and mobile screens.
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Repeated use of `text-[11px]` and `text-xs` (12px) for labels, badges, and status text.
issues.proposed_verification: Raise body and interactive control font floor to 14px–16px (`sub14Count === 0` on primary shell and cards).

issues.concept: Internal developer persistence filenames exposed in end-user copy
evidence: EVIDENCE/BEFORE/TC05_store_v5_darkmode_1440x900.png displays '10 unidades disponíveis no JSON' on ProductDetail.
EVIDENCE/BEFORE/TC09_dashboard_1440x900.png displays 'Valor recalculado via `skus.json`' inside the Sales KPI card.
issues.user_consequence: Exposes implementation internals ('JSON', '`skus.json`') in customer/merchant-facing copy.
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Debug verification copy left inside JSX strings after local sync refactoring.
issues.proposed_verification: Replace technical file strings with plain merchant status labels verified in copy lint.
